⚙️ Settings & Backup build 2026-08-17a
🎨 Appearance
Light mode is easier to read outdoors in daylight. AMOLED uses a true-black background — on OLED screens black pixels switch fully off, saving battery at night. Auto follows your phone/PC's system theme. Your choice is remembered on this device.
👤 Profiles
Each profile keeps its own completely separate data — expenses, plans, history, even its own Cloud Sync code. Great for a partner's budget or a business wallet. Switch anytime from the dropdown in the header.
📱 Payment QR codes
Save your QR Ph code from each wallet app (Maya, GoTyme, MariBank, RCBC…) as an image, then add it here. Tap 📱 My QR on the CC Split or Hangout page to show it full-screen for friends to scan. Any QR Ph code works from any InstaPay app.
☁️ Cloud Sync
Pick a sync code — any secret phrase you'll remember. Enter the same code on your other devices and they'll all share the same data. Make it long and unique (like a password) — anyone who knows it can see your data.
💾 Storage used
Everything lives in this browser's local storage (usually capped around ~5 MB). Wallet QR images and long histories take the most space — export a backup before it fills up.
—
📤 Export data
Downloads a .json file with everything — savings, bills, goals, tracker, split history. Copy it to another device or save as backup.
📊 Spreadsheet & paper
The backup file above is for restoring. These two are for using the data elsewhere — a .csv that opens in Sheets or Excel (necessities, subscriptions, installments, spending ledger, closed months, tracker, salary history), and a clean one-page sheet for the current ledger month you can print or save as PDF.
📥 Import data
Restore from a backup file. This replaces all current data on this device and reloads the app.
🤖 Chat AI optional
The 💬 chat understands plain commands on its own — offline, instantly, no key needed. Pick a provider here and it becomes a full assistant you can ask anything — questions about your money (“how much on subscriptions?”), or anything unrelated to budgeting. It can create Necessities, Subscription, Installment and Savings-goal rows for you (always behind a confirm card), knows today's date and your next payday, and can read a receipt photo into the Hangout or CC Split tab and parse a pasted bank/GCash SMS into expenses (prefix sms:). It also sees your spending ledger — what you actually spent, not just what you planned — so it can say which categories are drifting, and can log a spend for you (spent 450 on groceries). For anything current — news, rates, scores — prefix web: to run a live search (Google Search on Gemini, web search on Anthropic). Answers come with sources and can never change your data. Both cost an extra request; Anthropic bills per search. Any change to your data is only ever proposed — you confirm it, and Undo still works.
Second field is the model ID. If a request comes back saying the model is gone, tap List available models above — it asks your own key what it can actually call today, then tap one to use it.
The key is stored in this browser only. It is never synced, exported, or included in a backup — so you'll paste it once per device. Don't add one on a shared computer.

🏺 Sinking Funds
For the bills that only land once a year — registration, insurance, Christmas, dental. Each one divides what's left by the months left, and reserves that much every month, so the due month is already paid for. The monthly reserve appears as a budget line in your Spending Ledger; the bill itself doesn't, because it comes out of the pot.

🛍️ Wishlist
Things you're planning to buy — AirPods, a lens, a trip. In Save up mode each item shows how many paydays away it is at your current free-to-spend rate. Switch to Installment mode to preview the monthly amount and date range instead — and move it straight into your Installments when you buy.
💡 "What If" Date Range
See how a different rate would change your income over a specific date range — at the live exchange rate, without touching your actual settings. Working days are Sun–Thu, the same week the Hours & Pay tab uses. Leave rate or hours blank to use your current settings. Your savings and a one-off bonus add on; your Necessities, PayLater, and planned purchases for the range are deducted — giving a projected total you'd actually be left with.

📈 Net Worth
What you own minus what you owe, recorded once a month. Your spending history says where the money went; this says whether the pile is growing. Recorded automatically — the current month keeps updating, past months are frozen.
💵 Owed to You
Splits you fronted. Your share is already in the ledger below — this is everyone else's, tracked until they pay you back. Tap a name when the money arrives.
Still owed to you ₱0.00
🧾 Spending Ledger
Everything else here is a plan. This is the record — money that actually left. Log it by hand, send a receipt photo to the 💬 chat, or type log 250 groceries. Categories are guessed from what you have logged before. Close a month to freeze it into history — and, if an AI provider is set up, to have it written up once.
—
⛶ Split one payment
Each row becomes its own ledger entry, so every category bar, cap and average sees its real share. They stay grouped here and delete together.
🏦 Accounts where the money sits, and where each spend came from
→
A transfer is not spending, so it never touches a budget line, a cap, an average or a month-end total — it only records that the money changed hands between your own accounts.
🎯 Monthly caps the discretionary spend your bills don’t cover
A cap applies every month and gets its own bar below. It is a spending limit, not a bill — your Net Summary and obligations are untouched.
